_note: SYNTHETIC DATA. 200 invented support tickets modeled on healthcare transport dispatch software. No real customers, patients or staff. Generated by demo/scripts/build-tickets.mjs from demo/scripts/ticket-texts.json.

conversations.subject: Odometer field rejects our older vans
conversations.preview: The odometer entry rejects numbers over 99999. Our older vans are past that, so those drivers can't finish the start-of-day check.

conversations.subject: Calendar crashes every time we book a same-day discharge
conversations.preview: Hospital discharges are our most urgent bookings, and the booking calendar chokes on them. Today I tried to book a same-day discharge for a stretcher patient at 1:15. The calendar spun, then went white. I reloaded and the trip was not there. I tried again and now there might be two. I called your office and was told to ignore the duplicate, but how do I know which one the driver sees? The nurse manager is standing next to me waiting. This has to be the one thing that works reliably. Can you tell me whether discharge bookings have a special code path that is failing?

conversations.subject: broker penalty from duplicate import
conversations.preview: Our broker sent a late-pickup notice on a trip we never meant to run. Turns out their file import created the trip twice, one got assigned to a driver and the other sat unassigned until it timed out as a failed trip. Now it counts against our on-time performance. We need duplicate detection on imports or at least a report of what got merged.

conversations.subject: how do we stop crews being double scheduled
conversations.preview: Our scheduling lead keeps putting people on overlapping coverage because the system will let her. Is there a way to enforce a no-overlap rule on crew assignments? We had a medic on two units Friday and had to scramble a replacement from the on-call list. Call me at (614) 555-0182 if easier.

conversations.subject: standing orders keep needing re-entry
conversations.preview: We book dialysis standing orders for around 30 patients a week and every few weeks someone has to re-enter or fix them. Can the system auto-schedule our standing orders so they roll forward without us touching them, and just alert us when a patient is skipped or a chair time changes? That alone would save our front desk hours.

conversations.subject: Frequent freezes during shift change
conversations.preview: Between 6 and 7 in the morning, when the night crew hands off to day, the calendar freezes constantly. That's the busiest hour for transports we have. Is there a scheduled job running then that is hogging resources? I want something I can tell the team.

conversations.subject: No bulk reassign
conversations.preview: When a driver calls off we reassign trip by trip. There is no way to select the whole manifest or even a block of the morning and send it to one driver. On Monday a driver was out sick and moving his run took one of my dispatchers most of the early shift. Can bulk reassign go on the roadmap?

conversations.subject: Request: root cause for repeated board freezes
conversations.preview: I manage the account for our ambulance service and need a root cause I can pass to our leadership. Summary of the last month: nine reported freezes of the dispatch board, most between 5 and 7am, two on Mondays when recurring transports populate. Four of those ended with users logged out. In two cases the board lost an assignment we had made, and a crew went to the wrong facility. I'm not asking for blame, only for what is known: is it browser memory, a server timeout, a specific trip type? Please also tell me if there are supported browser versions. We have a compliance review next month and I want to write it down correctly.

conversations.subject: Month-end export took 4 hours
conversations.preview: Our month-end export took four hours to finish last night. We have about 11,000 trips a month. I started it at 4:30 and it wasn't ready until after 8:30, and billing can't start until it comes down. It used to take 20 minutes. Is there a way to schedule it overnight so it's ready in the morning?

conversations.subject: can't reassign fast enough, broker penalty incoming
conversations.preview: Third time this week a call-off has left us scrambling. Today it was a driver who texted at 0530 that his car wouldn't start. I had a full manifest of 10 trips to move. The reassign steps are unassign, modal, search, level of service, pickup window, save, then manually re-send the manifest, which is like fifteen clicks a trip. I got through seven before the first pickup window closed, and our broker will count that one late. I'd like a way to reassign a whole manifest at once and have it send automatically. Call me if you want details on the morning at 614-555-0138.

conversations.subject: overlapping interfacility transfers cost us a contractor
conversations.preview: On Thursday afternoon, three scheduled interfacility transfers and a discharge landed on a single BLS unit within a 40 minute window. The scheduler let us add each one without any warning and the board showed the unit as available. By the time the crew was running late on the second, the third and fourth were also running late, and we had to pay a contractor to take two of them. Cost us several hundred dollars and a call from the hospital's discharge coordinator. Our dispatchers are experienced, but the system really should tell them when a unit is overcommitted. Even a red outline on the board would do. Can this be added?

conversations.subject: Same-day adds make the board lag
conversations.preview: Whenever we get a batch of same-day adds in the afternoon the board starts to lag more with each one. By the fifth add it's frozen. We then have to reload and re-enter the last one. Dispatchers think the board redraws everything on each add.

conversations.subject: Sunday skeleton crew, one dispatcher, one call-off
conversations.preview: We run Sunday with one dispatcher and a handful of drivers. This weekend a wheelchair driver called off at 0615 and I was alone on the board. Every reassign is the same long chain: open the trip, unassign, confirm the modal, search the list, level of service, pickup window, save, re-send the manifest. It was a mix of PT visits and two dialysis returns, and I could not leave the screen to answer the phones in the meantime. Two patients were picked up 25 minutes late and one facility asked for a written explanation. I realize weekends are quieter, but a single dispatcher cannot do this at 12 clicks a trip. Anything that lets one person move a manifest in one action would matter a lot to us. - Tomas

conversations.subject: Reassign on the calendar view
conversations.preview: Some of my dispatchers use the calendar view instead of the board and reassigning from there is even worse. You can't drag the trip to another driver, so you open the trip, go through the whole unassign and search and save process, and then the calendar refreshes and shows last week. We do around 12 clicks per move. When a standing order driver calls off we end up using the board, but then lose the week view of who is covered. Can the calendar support drag to reassign and keep its date when it refreshes?

conversations.subject: Need help: board takes minutes to load on slow connections
conversations.preview: A few of our rural dispatchers work from home on slower connections and the board takes three to four minutes to load, if it loads at all. The page seems to pull the entire week. Could the board load day by day or lazy load the trips? Right now they're working from emailed run sheets. You can reach me at ops.manager@example.com or (404) 555-0139 any time after 3.

conversations.subject: Billing CSV is missing columns the broker needs
conversations.preview: The month-end billing CSV used to include level of service, loaded miles, and the authorization number. After the last update it only has the trip ID, date, and status columns, and the column order changed, so our billing person can't paste it into the broker template anymore. We re-run it three times hoping it comes back right. We're about to miss the broker's submission deadline on the 15th. If this is a template setting I can change on my side, please tell me where, because I couldn't find it.

conversations.subject: crew double scheduled
conversations.preview: Medic 3 crew is on the schedule for the day shift AND a dialysis transfer shift tonight. Nothing flagged it. Please look at this.

conversations.subject: two units sent to same BLS transfer
conversations.preview: Two dispatchers took the same interfacility BLS transfer request, one over the phone and one from the facility portal, and we sent two units. Tied up a crew for 40 minutes. The board had both as separate trips with identical pickup times. Can duplicate checks look at pickup time and origin?

conversations.subject: stretcher filter hangs
conversations.preview: Level of service filter set to stretcher hangs the whole calendar. Ambulatory and wheelchair are fine.

conversations.subject: week view blank
conversations.preview: Week view is blank for our facility since yesterday afternoon. Day view still works. Can someone look?

conversations.subject: two dispatchers, one trip, two vans
conversations.preview: Overnight we have two of us on the board and it keeps happening. A same-day add came in at 0215 for a stretcher transfer. I took it and assigned a stretcher van. My coworker saw it as unassigned in her view (it hadn't refreshed yet) and assigned a second van. The board then showed both vans on the trip, no conflict, no popup. Two crews drove to the same pickup and one was a wasted trip, about 45 minutes of dead miles. Is there a record lock or at least a warning when someone else assigned a trip in the last few seconds? We shouldn't have to yell across the room. - Andre

conversations.subject: Facility portal calendar loses our bookings on crash
conversations.preview: I coordinate rides for a dialysis center and I enter next week's changes every Thursday afternoon, usually thirty to forty trips. Twice now the booking calendar has frozen in the middle and when I reload, anywhere from three to ten of the rides I'd entered are gone, with no error. I only found out because a patient's ride didn't show up. Now I take a screenshot of every single booking, which doubles the time. Can the portal save as I go? Or tell me clearly which bookings were accepted? My director is asking if we should look at other providers.

conversations.subject: Dispatch board crashes when dragging a trip
conversations.preview: If I drag a trip from unassigned onto a driver row the board freezes about half the time. When it comes back the trip is either on both drivers or on nobody. Costs me double checks by phone every time.

conversations.subject: Week view slow when we have more than 250 trips
conversations.preview: Week view used to load in a few seconds. Since we picked up a second broker contract it takes close to 90 seconds, and it times out some days. Day view is okay. We're running mostly wheelchair and ambulatory dialysis runs. Is there a trip limit we're hitting, or something we can set to make it lighter?

conversations.subject: SSO redirect loop after the IdP certificate change
conversations.preview: Since our IT rotated the identity provider certificate on Monday, everyone who signs in with SSO gets bounced back to the login page in a loop. Password login still works for the three of us who have local accounts, but the whole dispatch floor is SSO only. We're operating off the three local logins and sharing terminals, which our compliance officer is not going to like. What do we need to update on your side?

conversations.subject: trip stuck on en route
conversations.preview: Trip 48213 has said en route for 2 hours. Driver says he dropped at the clinic an hour ago and tapped arrived and complete.

conversations.subject: wound care trip stuck unassigned
conversations.preview: Moved the 0900 wound care trip to another driver and had to re-enter the pickup window. Fat-fingered it, saved the wrong time, and it sat there unnoticed. Too many fields to retype on a reassign.

conversations.subject: ride booked twice and neither showed
conversations.preview: Hello, our unit booked a wheelchair ride home for a patient being discharged. A second nurse booked the same ride about ten minutes later because the first one hadn't shown up yet in the portal list. The transport company then had two trips for the same patient and apparently cancelled one, and I guess the system dropped the wrong one because by 4pm no van had come. We waited over three hours. The patient's family was upset and we had to find another way. Could the portal show a banner saying a ride already exists when we try to book for the same person and time? It would save us a lot of embarrassment. Thanks.

conversations.subject: Texts to landline numbers fail silently
conversations.preview: A number of our recurring patients have landlines on file. The system accepts them, says notification sent, and nothing ever arrives. We only learned this when the family called. Can it flag numbers that can't receive texts, or fall back to an automated call?

conversations.subject: lost my edits
conversations.preview: Board froze mid reassign and when I reloaded the edits were gone. Had to call two drivers back to confirm who had what.

conversations.subject: Offline mode eating our status updates on the highway runs
conversations.preview: Our rural stretcher runs lose cell coverage for 15 to 20 minutes on the highway stretch. The driver app is supposed to queue status changes offline, but when the unit comes back into coverage the picked up and dropped off taps from the dead zone are gone. The trip just sits on picked up on the board, or falls back to en route. Last week four interfacility BLS transfers had no drop-off status and we couldn't close them out, so billing is holding them because the times are missing. We've told crews to screenshot the app but that's not a process. Is the offline queue supposed to survive the app being backgrounded? Two crews said a phone call came in during the dead zone and the app restarted afterward.

conversations.subject: dialysis run, can't move the legs together
conversations.preview: Our three-times-a-week dialysis riders are round trips. When a driver is out I have to open the outbound leg, reassign it, then open the return leg, reassign it again, and re-enter the pickup window. Twice I did only one leg and the patient got picked up with no one scheduled to bring them home. Please link the legs.

conversations.subject: Monday morning standing order load kills the board
conversations.preview: Every Monday around 5:15 when the standing orders generate for the week, the board takes forever and then goes unresponsive. We have roughly 300 trips on Monday and it never recovers without closing Chrome. Our workaround is to have one dispatcher open the board on a second browser before the load runs, which seems to help a little. Please look at this, it's every single week. Please cc our billing person at billing.ops@example.org on the reply.

conversations.subject: broker import duplicates cause two vans
conversations.preview: Broker CSV import loaded a duplicate of every trip for one facility after we re-uploaded a corrected file. I did not notice until a driver radioed that his rider was already in another van. Please add a duplicate check for imports, or let us roll back an import.

conversations.subject: broker flagged us for trips we didn't run
conversations.preview: Our broker audit report has 9 trips marked as no-show by us last week. When I dug in, these were duplicates created by the import. The broker's file lists each trip once, but we pull it twice a day and the second pull creates new trips for any rider whose pickup time was edited by the broker. So there is one real trip and one orphan. The orphan never gets a driver, times out, and counts as a failed trip against our performance. Trips 62014, 62019 and 62040 are examples, the rest are in the trip log. I need two things: a way to dedupe imports by broker reference, and a report that shows which trips were created by import vs manually. Right now I'm hand-checking every morning and that is not sustainable.

conversations.subject: is the ride booked twice?
conversations.preview: I see two entries for tomorrow's 1:15 return from physical therapy, one will-call and one with a set time. I only requested one. Please confirm which is active so our front desk isn't confused when two vans pull up.

conversations.subject: Everything is slow after the broker import
conversations.preview: Here is what I see every morning. The broker file lands around 4:30. We import it and the import itself finishes fine. Then the board, which had been responsive, becomes slow, and by about 5:00 it freezes completely when I try to filter by level of service. I tried stretcher, then wheelchair, then ambulatory, and each one crashed the tab. After a hard refresh it's usable but not by much. My guess is the board is trying to draw every new leg at once. We have about 400 trips on busy mornings. Is there a way to stage the import or load the board lazily? I'd happily test something for you. Best number is 216-555-0171.

conversations.subject: On-time performance numbers don't match the broker
conversations.preview:
Your on-time report says we were 96.2 percent on time in September. The broker's scorecard says 89 percent. We compared a sample of 40 trips and the difference is that the report counts a trip on time if the driver arrived before the end of the pickup window, while the broker measures against the scheduled pickup time plus 15 minutes. Can the report calculate it the broker's way, or at least show both? I'm going into a quarterly review with the broker next week and I can't defend two different numbers.
- Terrence

conversations.subject: auto reassign when a crew calls off
conversations.preview: Can the system automatically reassign a trip when a driver calls off? Something that finds the next available crew with the right level of service and proposes the moves, so I'm not rebuilding the schedule at 0600 while taking 911 overflow calls. Even a suggestion list would help us. We lose too much time to calling around.

conversations.subject: Calendar hangs on the trip log link
conversations.preview: Clicking a trip on the board to open the trip log makes the calendar hang for a long time on busy days. Then half the time it goes back to the login page. I only need a pickup time and a note, but it takes minutes.

conversations.subject: Booking calendar won't load
conversations.preview: Our facility booking calendar just shows a loading wheel this morning. We have three dialysis returns to enter. Is it down?

conversations.subject: extra clicks add up to overtime
conversations.preview: Dispatch overtime is up and I traced part of it to reassignment. Our dispatchers spend roughly 12 clicks and a page reload per trip, and on call-off days that's close to an hour of the shift. I'd like to see a faster flow, even just remembering the last driver searched. - Dennis

conversations.subject: Month view is unusable
conversations.preview: Month view takes over a minute to load and then freezes when you click a day. We only use it for standing order checks and now we can't.

conversations.subject: Competitor has AI dispatch
conversations.preview: Short version: our biggest competitor announced AI dispatch and my exec team wants to know our answer. Do you have anything planned for auto-assignment or smart dispatch? I need something I can tell them this quarter.

conversations.subject: cannot see PT rides on calendar view
conversations.preview: Our PT rides for the week used to appear on the calendar and now the page just freezes before they show. Our therapy staff are asking the front desk about rides and we have no answer. Could this be related to the update last week?

conversations.subject: Interfacility transfers: auto-assign nearest unit
conversations.preview: For interfacility BLS transfers we'd like the system to auto-assign the nearest available unit with the right certification, and when a unit is pulled for a 911 call, re-offer the transfer to the next closest one without a dispatcher touching it. Today a dispatcher watches the board all day and reassigns by hand, and at shift change things slip. We've had two late transfers in a month for this reason. Our night dispatcher is on 312-555-0147 if your team wants to understand how the shift handoff really goes.

conversations.subject: Trip log has no pickup or drop-off times for a chunk of trips
conversations.preview: The broker trip log export has blank pickup and drop-off timestamps for roughly one in eight trips from last week. They are the ones where the driver was in a dead zone or had to log back in during the run. The broker audits these logs and treats blank times as unsupported trips. I need either a way to backfill the times from the GPS breadcrumbs or someone to tell me where the data went.

conversations.subject: filter by vehicle crashes the board
conversations.preview: Filtering by vehicle kills the tab every time. No error, just goes grey and stops responding. My cell is (614) 555-0182 if someone can call back.

conversations.subject: Utilization report times out
conversations.preview: The unit utilization report times out if I pick anything longer than 10 days. I need 30 for our quarterly review with the medical director and it just spins and then gives a gateway error. I've been running it three days at a time and adding them together in a spreadsheet, which I don't love, because transfers that span midnight get counted twice.

conversations.subject: please add drag and drop to the board
conversations.preview: I have used two other dispatch tools before this one and every one of them let me drag a trip card from one driver lane to another. Here I have to open the trip, unassign, confirm a modal, search the driver list, re-check level of service, re-enter the pickup window, save, and re-send the manifest. I counted 15 clicks yesterday. When I'm covering a will-call surge at the end of a dialysis block, a drag would let me keep eyes on the whole board instead of buried in a form. Is drag and drop planned?

conversations.subject: Our supervisors can't edit trips
conversations.preview: Supervisors can open a trip but every field is greyed out. They used to be able to change the pickup time and level of service. I haven't touched roles since August. I need them editing trips because dispatchers are tied up during the morning peak and I'm out of hands.

conversations.subject: Nothing tells us a will-call return was scheduled
conversations.preview: When our dialysis nurse calls in a will-call return, we get no confirmation back that it was scheduled, who is coming, or when. So the nurse calls again twenty minutes later to make sure it went through, and sometimes then you create a second return. It would help if the system just texted the unit when the return gets a time.

conversations.subject: Standing order load on Mondays is killing us
conversations.preview: Our Monday load is the real problem. Standing orders generate overnight and by 5am about 280 legs are on the board. The week view will not render, the day view takes a minute, and any edit makes it freeze again. We lose roughly forty minutes of dispatcher time every Monday, which in practice means a couple of late dialysis pickups and a broker penalty risk. I've asked the team to do the early reassignments from the printed manifest and only touch the board after 7. That's not a plan, it's a bandage. Is there any chance the standing orders could be generated earlier in the night so the board isn't also drawing them live?

conversations.subject: Month view and week view both fail on large weeks
conversations.preview: Looking for guidance and a fix. When a week has more than about 1,500 legs, which happens around holidays because we add extra capacity trips, both the month view and the week view fail to load. Day view works. I need the week view to see driver hours and overtime before payroll. I've been exporting the manifests for each driver, which takes hours. Is there a supported way to load in pieces, or to filter the week by vehicle type without the calendar choking? If there's a hard limit, I'd like to know so I can plan around it. Thanks - Dennis, ops

conversations.subject: Facility complaints about ETAs are eating the dispatch desk
conversations.preview: Over the last two weeks the number of facility calls asking where is my driver has tripled and my dispatchers are spending about half the day on them. The root cause as I see it is the ETA text. It either doesn't go at all, or it goes with a number that hasn't moved since the first ping because the driver app wasn't reporting. Facilities that used to call twice a day now call six times. One hospital has put it in writing that they are reconsidering us for discharge rides. Please tell me whether there is a setting to send ETA updates when the estimate changes by more than 10 minutes, because that would help a lot.

conversations.subject: wheelchair van double dispatched
conversations.preview: I assigned wheelchair van 22 to a 0900 PT trip and later a same-day add at 0910 came in for the other side of town. System accepted it, no yellow flag, nothing. Driver took the first one and the second rider was a no-show on our end because nobody covered it. Rider's facility called to complain.

conversations.subject: scrolling freezes
conversations.preview: Scrolling down the day view past the 9am trips freezes the browser. Worse on Mondays when the standing orders drop.

conversations.subject: not asking for AI but...
conversations.preview: I'm not asking for AI, honestly. Last tool we used had an auto-scheduler that ignored level of service and put a wheelchair van on a stretcher trip. If you build any kind of auto-assign, make it a suggestion a dispatcher has to approve, and make it respect required parameters. Otherwise I'd rather keep doing it by hand and have the board load faster. Just my two cents from nine years of dispatching.

conversations.subject: reassign steps, wasted time on transfers
conversations.preview: Our dispatchers are experienced and they still say moving a transfer between crews is the most tedious thing in the system. Open the call, unassign, confirm, search the unit, re-check level of service, re-enter the pickup window, save, send the manifest again. Fine, but it also doesn't let me move a return leg with the outbound leg, so a round trip is double the clicks. We cc our billing person on these incidents at billing@example.org because late transfers affect claims. I'd like to talk about a faster workflow.

conversations.subject: Lost unsaved edits and forced logout on the calendar
conversations.preview: We have had a series of incidents where the calendar crashes and forces the user back to the login page. The problem is not only the crash. It is that all unsaved edits are lost, including notes on pickup instructions and level of service changes that dispatchers had just typed. Last Tuesday one dispatcher lost about twenty minutes of same-day add changes. I would like to know whether there is a session timeout interacting with the crash, and whether you have a draft recovery feature. I can send browser console output if that helps, just tell me how to collect it. For now I have asked staff to keep a text file open for anything important.

conversations.subject: dialysis return trips booked in duplicate
conversations.preview: We book rides for about 40 patients a week through your portal. Last Friday I noticed three of our return trips were duplicated: same patient, same pickup window, one marked will-call and one with a time. I didn't create both. I think when the transport company confirmed the original, the system made a second one. We got a call from a driver who said he was sent twice. I think two different drivers went. Please check trip 55302 and tell us what happened. Our dialysis patients can't wait in the lobby while we sort out which van is real. Also, can we see a trip log that shows who created each trip?

conversations.subject: Can't book same-day adds since the staff change
conversations.preview: Since our new coordinator was added last week she can book scheduled rides in the portal but the same-day add button is missing. I'm the other coordinator and I can see it. We have discharges to book every afternoon and I'm out Thursday and Friday. Please check her role.

conversations.subject: Cancelled trip still showing, trip 51907
conversations.preview: Love that the driver app still shows trip 51907, cancelled Thursday. Very exciting for the driver. He went anyway.

conversations.subject: Reminder texts are going out an hour after the pickup time
conversations.preview: The reminder texts that are supposed to go the evening before are arriving after the ride. We've had three no-shows on the morning run that I'm confident come from this. A member told our driver she got the text at 8:40 for an 8:00 pickup. Can someone check the send queue?

conversations.subject: Duplicate trip lines in driver app overnight
conversations.preview: After a reassign, the same trip is showing twice on the new driver's manifest, one active and one greyed out. Drivers aren't sure which to tap, and one started the wrong one and marked the member as picked up before arriving. You can reach the night dispatcher on 312-555-0147 if you need to see it live, she saw it twice last night.

conversations.subject: Facility calendar crashes when adding a return leg
conversations.preview: When I add a return leg on the booking calendar the page freezes and I have to refresh. Half the time the outbound leg saved and the return didn't, so I'm never sure what actually got booked. I've started calling your dispatch line to confirm every return before we leave for the day.

conversations.subject: crew overlap shift mess
conversations.preview: We run a mix of 911 backup and scheduled interfacility transfers. This weekend our scheduler built two shifts for the same paramedic: a 0700 to 1900 on Medic 2 and a 1800 to 0600 night shift on Medic 4. The overlap is an hour but nothing warned us, and when the crew sheet printed we both assumed it was fine. The paramedic showed up at 0700 and then didn't realize he was also expected at 1800 and was already 11 hours in. That's fatigue plus overtime and a possible compliance problem. I'd like the shift builder to block or warn on overlapping assignments, and to show a summary of hours for the week while building. At a minimum let us run a conflict report at the end of the day.

conversations.subject: after the update the week view is basically broken
conversations.preview: Since Wednesday's update week view takes over two minutes to load and half the time we get the page unresponsive popup. It's not our computers, we tried four different machines. Day view works but we can't plan ahead without the week. We run mostly recurring dialysis legs plus interfacility transfers, so we need the week view to check weekend coverage. Right now one of us is working from a spreadsheet of next week's standing orders to figure out which units are free. Could you roll back the update or tell us a timeline? We have crews asking me every shift.

conversations.subject: Alerts are going to a number nobody uses
conversations.preview:
I have been trying for two weeks to get the pickup alerts moved off our old front desk line, which now rings in an empty office. Every ride we book still sends the ETA to that line, so our staff are blind on arrivals and we missed a wheelchair return on Tuesday because of it. I changed the contact in the portal and it saved, but the texts still go to the old number. If someone can fix this on your side, the number to use is (614) 555-0182, that's the nurse station cell and it's answered all shift. Third request. I'd also like to know why the portal says one thing and the alert goes somewhere else.
- Renee

conversations.subject: Billing role has no export button
conversations.preview: Our billing clerk has the billing role but the export button is missing from her reports screen. I can see it as admin. She needs the CSV for the broker batch on Friday.

conversations.subject: Start and end mileage not saving from the crew tablets
conversations.preview:
Mileage entries on the crew tablets are not saving about half the time. The crew types the end odometer, hits submit, gets no error, and the trip log shows blank loaded miles. We found it when a stack of interfacility transfers came back from billing with no mileage. Crews swear they entered it. We have maybe 30 trips from the past two weeks affected and the broker wants them corrected by Friday. Please cc our billing person at billing.lead@example.org on any reply, since she's the one chasing the corrections and she needs to know which trips can be recovered.
- Dana

conversations.subject: Board goes grey when a unit goes out of service
conversations.preview: When I mark a unit out of service the board goes grey for a few seconds and then freezes. Today an ambulance had to come out of service in the middle of a busy afternoon, with four scheduled interfacility transports on its manifest. I couldn't reassign them because the board wouldn't come back. I eventually used a second browser, which worked, so it seems tied to the first session's state. The transports ended up going out about 30 minutes late. I'd like to know if marking a unit out of service while trips are on its manifest is a known problem.

conversations.subject: Signature won't save on wheelchair trips
conversations.preview: The signature pad in the driver app isn't saving. The driver gets the signature, hits done, and gets a red error that says could not upload signature, and the trip can't be completed. Five wheelchair trips Tuesday morning were stuck open because of it. Drivers are writing on paper now and we'll key it in later. Wi-Fi at the garage works fine, it's only in the field.

conversations.subject: urgent!!
conversations.preview: Day view has been spinning for 10 minutes at 5am and I have 40 trips to get out. Is something down on your end?

conversations.subject: Escalating: board unreliable for 3 weeks
conversations.preview: I am escalating because we have now lost three weeks of reliable operation. The board white-screens on the week view, freezes on filter, and kicks users to the login page when it recovers. Our dispatchers keep a paper backup of every run sheet printed the night before, which means extra overtime and a lot of calls to crews to confirm. We handle a mix of scheduled dialysis transports and interfacility BLS, and the 911 overflow we pick up means we can't afford a dark board. I would like a named person to work with us, and a written explanation of what changed in the last update. Our contract includes uptime expectations.

conversations.subject: please fix duplicate trips from standing orders
conversations.preview: This is our third ticket about this. Each time a facility edits a recurring dialysis standing order, the system leaves the old series active and creates a new one. Last week it hit four facilities. At 0600 on Monday we had 38 trips on the board that were duplicates and two drivers got sent to riders who had already been picked up. Dispatchers spent the first two hours of the shift manually cancelling trips instead of dispatching. We're a small team and that hurt. I understand the edit flow might be hard to fix quickly, but can you at least add a warning when two recurring series for the same rider overlap, and a one-click way to remove the older series? Otherwise I'll have to tell the facilities to stop editing orders, which is a non-starter.

conversations.subject: Day view white after ctrl+refresh
conversations.preview: Day view loads for a second, then the whole thing turns white. I can see it flash the trips first. Tried clearing cache and a different profile and same result. My coworker on the same account sees it fine, so maybe it's tied to my machine, but I have no idea what.

conversations.subject: Location stops when crews switch to the nav app
conversations.preview: The driver app stops sending location about a minute after the crew switches to their navigation app. The dot freezes on the board, and the ETA that goes to the hospital is just whatever it was at the last ping. Two discharge facilities called asking why the unit hadn't moved in 20 minutes. Is there a setting to keep the app reporting in the background?

conversations.subject: driver scheduled for overlapping shifts
conversations.preview: Looks like a driver got put on the 0600 manifest and the 1400 manifest on the same day but the 0600 run to the dialysis center and back was already a 9 hour day. He is now in overtime and he is not happy. The scheduler did not warn me when I added the second shift. Is overtime or overlap supposed to be checked?

conversations.subject: unit double booked
conversations.preview: Unit 7 got put on two interfacility BLS transfers with overlapping windows. Is there a setting to block this?

conversations.subject: Overnight crew logged out at midnight
conversations.preview: Sessions seem to expire at 0000. The overnight shift gets logged out and nobody notices until the 0200 interfacility pickup shows nothing on the unit. Had to radio the whole run in. Happened Friday and again last night.

conversations.subject: Logged out when calendar crashes - security or bug?
conversations.preview: When the calendar crashes our people end up on the login screen and have to sign in again, which loses whatever was unsaved. Is that intended behavior for a crash? I'm trying to decide whether to tell the crews to save more often or whether you are fixing it. Please advise.

conversations.subject: crew conflict on schedule
conversations.preview: We had two EMTs on the roster for two different units at the same time Saturday night. The system lets you assign the same crew member to more than one unit if the shifts overlap and doesn't flag it. Can you tell me if there is a validation setting I'm missing or if this needs a feature request? Reply to sched.admin@example.net, thanks.

conversations.subject: New assignment alerts come in 10 minutes late
conversations.preview: New assignment alerts on the crew phones arrive 10 minutes after I assign, and sometimes only once the crew opens the app. We've had a crew sit at the station while a transfer waited because nothing buzzed. Our rule is dispatch calls the crew if there's no ack in 3 minutes, so now the phone is half my job.

conversations.subject: 2FA code never arrives
conversations.preview: The two-factor text isn't coming to my phone and I can't get into the board. I have tried 5 times in the last hour. If you need to verify me, the dispatch office line is (312) 555-0129 and someone will pick up. Can you switch me to an authenticator app or reset it?

conversations.subject: AI dispatch assistant?
conversations.preview: Our owner read that a competitor just launched an AI dispatch feature and has asked me twice when we are getting one. I'd like something that looks at the unassigned trips each morning, proposes driver assignments, and lets my dispatcher approve them with one click. Do you have an AI dispatch assistant on the roadmap, and is there a beta I can join?

conversations.subject: overtime from double scheduled driver
conversations.preview: Payroll flagged a driver with 14 hours on a day he was only supposed to work 8. The board had him on two manifests that overlapped, one from an old template and one built manually. Nobody got warned. We'd like the scheduler to block or at least warn on overlapping manifests.

conversations.subject: Same-day add never showed up on the unit's app
conversations.preview: I added a 1:40 hospital discharge, assigned it to unit 2, and the board showed it assigned. Unit 2 never got the notification or the trip. The dispatcher up front saw unit 2 as open, so he assigned it a second transport at the same time. We ended up with one crew double dispatched and a discharge patient waiting an extra hour. Trip 50672 if you want to look.

conversations.subject: Facility user sees other facilities' trips - serious
conversations.preview: One of our facility users logged into the portal and is seeing trips that belong to a different dialysis center, including pickup times and the trip notes. She reported it to us this morning. We pulled her account and she is only assigned to her own facility. This looks like a data exposure and I need to know how it happened and whether others had the same access. It's the second report this month, and I told the first one it was a one-off. In the meantime I have turned off portal access for all facility users on that group, so please advise quickly on a fix, because the facilities need to book tomorrow's standing orders and the notifications they depend on are tied to those accounts. Please escalate this to whoever handles security.

conversations.subject: Two vans at the same dialysis center
conversations.preview: Monday morning two of our vans showed up for the same 0630 dialysis rider. The trip had been entered once by the facility through the portal and once by our own intake, and the system accepted both as separate trips. Nothing on the board said possible duplicate. We lost two driver hours and the other rider on that route went out late. Can you add a duplicate warning on same rider, same pickup window?

conversations.subject: stretcher vs wheelchair in the driver list
conversations.preview: When I go to reassign a stretcher trip the driver list is alphabetical and includes wheelchair-only vans. I have to remember who is in what vehicle. A filter by vehicle type would save me a lot of guessing and a lot of bad assignments. Twice this week I picked wrong and had to start over.

conversations.subject: Need the corrected export for the broker resubmission
conversations.preview: The first export for the broker's September resubmission has missing pickup times on about 60 trips. Once your team has a fixed version, please send the file to ops.lead@example.org as well as posting it in the admin portal, since our ops lead is the one signing the attestation and she doesn't log in daily. We've got until the 20th.

conversations.subject: New dispatcher can't see the board
conversations.preview: I created a login for our new dispatcher this morning and gave her the dispatcher role. She can sign in, but the board is empty for her and the trips tab says no access. My other dispatchers see everything. I can't see anything wrong in her profile. She starts solo on the evening shift tomorrow, so I need this sorted today.

conversations.subject: round trips
conversations.preview: Reassigning the A leg doesn't move the return leg. I have to do both separately and I forgot once. Missed will-call pickup today because of it.

conversations.subject: ETA stuck at 15 min
conversations.preview: The ETA on our trip has said 15 minutes for two hours now.

conversations.subject: you reload the page after every reassign
conversations.preview: I know it seems minor but the full page reload after saving a reassignment is killing me. I'm working the board filtered to the afternoon, I move a trip, and the filter resets and I land at the top of the day. During a call-off I'm doing this 20 or 30 times. On Thursday I lost track of which trips I had already moved and nearly double dispatched a van. Please make the board update in place and keep my view. If you need a screen recording I can send one. - Priya, night dispatch

conversations.subject: slow during the morning rush
conversations.preview: We run more than 40 trips between 0600 and 0900. When we lose a unit it feels like the system fights us. Each move is a long chain of screens and I'm standing there waiting on the reload. Our broker counts every late pickup against us, and I can't afford to spend a minute and a half per trip.

conversations.subject: Weekly booking calendar broke after you changed the layout
conversations.preview: I don't want to sound like I'm complaining about change for the sake of it, but since the layout changed last week our weekly booking calendar loads extremely slowly. It used to be one page with all our dialysis rides listed. Now it takes forever, sometimes freezes, and the scroll bar jumps around. I only book a few dozen rides a week so I assume the problem is on your side. Several of our staff have gone back to faxing the list to the provider's office, which defeats the purpose of having a portal. Is the old layout still available? If you need to see my screen I can share it.

conversations.subject: dialysis standing orders not showing on calendar
conversations.preview: The calendar page loads but our dialysis standing orders for next week show as a blank grid. Refreshing makes it spin. We can't tell if the rides are booked, so I called the provider to double-check each one. Please look into it soon.

conversations.subject: Calendar freezes after broker import
conversations.preview: We import the broker file each morning and as soon as it finishes the calendar locks up. Clicking anything gives the page unresponsive warning. If I wait about four minutes it sometimes comes back, but not always. Last Thursday I just gave up and worked from a printed manifest for the whole morning shift.

conversations.subject: Claims denied for incomplete trip logs
conversations.preview: We had 22 claims denied this month because the payer said the trip record was missing times, origin and destination type, or service level. When we pull the trip logs, the data is blank on exactly those trips. Looking at them, they all had the driver app lose signal or the crew complete the call on a second device. So the call happened, the patient was transported, and the dispatch data never made it into the record. Each denied claim is hundreds of dollars, and appeals are eating my billing clerk's whole week. I need to know whether the data exists somewhere in the system that we can pull manually, and whether there's a fix coming for how times are saved when the app is offline.

conversations.subject: Training new dispatchers on reassign is painful
conversations.preview: I train every new dispatcher and the reassign flow is where they struggle. It's eight different steps, a confirmation modal that interrupts, a driver list with no vehicle type filter, and a level of service field that resets so they pick it again. Then they forget to re-send the manifest. Last week a new hire reassigned a same-day add to a driver who had a wheelchair van for a stretcher trip because the list didn't show vehicle type. We caught it before pickup, but barely. Could the flow be shortened and the list filtered by vehicle? I'd rather fix the tool than write a longer SOP.

conversations.subject: van 3 teleporting
conversations.preview: Van 3 keeps teleporting on the board. One minute it's at the dialysis center and the next it's 8 miles north. The driver is parked. Happens every morning around 0600.

conversations.subject: Arrived status stuck on every standing order dialysis run
conversations.preview: Every Monday, Wednesday and Friday our standing order dialysis runs get stuck on arrived. The driver taps Arrived, the app confirms, and the board keeps showing en route until the driver taps Picked Up. That means the arrival time on the board is 20 to 30 minutes later than reality. Then the facility's own sign-in sheet shows our driver there at 0640 and our board says 0712, and the broker is reading that as a late pickup. We've already had one penalty notice because of it. I need to know if the arrived tap is being recorded at all, or if it's just not displaying. Right now our on-time number for that route is wrong in both directions.

conversations.subject: Cancelled wound care trip still live on the manifest
conversations.preview: A facility cancelled a 2:30 wound care trip at noon. We cancelled it on the board and it shows grey for us, but the driver still had it on his manifest with the green Start button. He drove 20 minutes out there, found no one, and it got logged as a no-show against us. Can you check why cancels aren't pushing to the app? It happened with two other trips on Monday too.

conversations.subject: Arrived button spins forever on older phones
conversations.preview: Three of our drivers on the older Android phones tap Arrived at the pickup and the button spins, then goes back to En Route. The board never shows arrived, so the wait clock never starts and our on-time numbers are off. Newer phones are fine. We can't replace six phones this month. Is there a known issue with older OS versions?

conversations.subject: Calendar is slow every Monday
conversations.preview: Monday mornings our booking calendar takes forever to load, sometimes five or six minutes. By Wednesday it's fast again. We book our standing order changes first thing on Monday so we are always the ones stuck waiting. Is there a better time to log in?

conversations.subject: No arrival alert for a same-day discharge
conversations.preview: We booked a same-day discharge for a patient with a hard 3 hour window from the broker. The patient was ready at 2, the unit had no idea when the driver would show, and we kept the family waiting in the lobby. The driver arrived at 3:20 and nobody told us. Please add an alert when the driver is 10 minutes out for discharge rides at least.

conversations.subject: Board crashed during the 5am rush
conversations.preview: Around 4:50 this morning the board froze while I was assigning the first wave of dialysis transports. By the time it came back we had two units sitting with no manifest and a facility calling to ask where the crew was. I ended up reading trip details off my email to the crew by radio. This is the worst possible time for it to fail. Send updates to dispatch.lead@example.net or reach the night dispatcher on 773-555-0126.

conversations.subject: Live location is 5 minutes behind
conversations.preview: The location dots for our BLS units lag by 4 to 6 minutes. I assigned a same-day add to the unit that looked closest, and it turned out to already be across town. The interfacility transfer ran 25 minutes past the pickup window and the hospital charge nurse was not happy. If the dots on the board aren't live I can't dispatch off them.

conversations.subject: drag and drop?
conversations.preview: Is there any way to drag a trip from one driver's row to another on the board? We have to open every single trip to reassign it.

conversations.subject: Tuesday was a mess - van sent twice to same rider
conversations.preview:
Writing up what happened Tuesday so you can look at the trip log. At 0540 we had a standing-order dialysis rider on the board assigned to one driver. Around 0600 the facility added the same ride through the portal because they thought the standing order had expired, and the system created a second trip with a slightly different pickup window instead of warning anyone. Both went to different drivers and both showed up at the same time. One driver was then 35 minutes late to his next rider, who is also on dialysis, so the center had a chair empty. This has happened before. If the system can show a warning when the same rider has two trips within a couple hours, that would be enough.
- Marisol, dispatch lead

conversations.subject: calendar unresponsive when filtering twice
conversations.preview: Found a way to make it crash every time, if it helps your team. Open day view, filter by vehicle, then add a level of service filter on top. The board hangs and Chrome says the page is unresponsive. Done with only one filter it's fine. We use the double filter all the time to find a wheelchair van with an open slot for a same-day add, so we are stuck. I tried it on three machines and my coworker saw the same thing. Workaround for now is filter, write down the open vans, clear it, then filter again. It's slow when the lobby is full of riders waiting. - Priya

conversations.subject: Reassign flow, 12 clicks per trip
conversations.preview: I counted. 12 clicks to move a single interfacility BLS transfer from one crew to another. Open, unassign, OK on the modal, search crew, pick, re-check level of service, re-enter the pickup window, save. Then I still have to re-send the manifest. We do this 15 or 20 times a week when units get pulled for 911 calls.

conversations.subject: Facility got three driver assigned texts for one transfer
conversations.preview: I reassigned a transfer twice in ten minutes because a unit got pulled to a 911 call. Each reassign sent the facility a new driver assigned text, so the charge nurse got three for the same trip and called us confused about which crew was coming. Can the alerts be held until the assignment settles, or at least say that the crew has changed?

conversations.subject: Great, the portal says the driver is on the way
conversations.preview: The portal says the driver is on the way. It has said that since this morning. The driver has not arrived. Thanks for the clarity.

conversations.subject: ETA said 7:20, van arrived at 6:50
conversations.preview: The ETA in the text for our 7am dialysis group said 7:20, so the staff told the patients to wait inside. The van pulled up at 6:50 and left after 5 minutes because nobody came out. Two of our patients missed their chair time and we had to reshuffle the schedule. The ETA seems to be computed off the scheduled time rather than where the van actually is.

conversations.subject: overlap not caught
conversations.preview: We scheduled a stretcher unit for a discharge and a PT transport in the same pickup window. No warning at all, we just found it on the manifest.

conversations.subject: Zooming out week view crashes browser
conversations.preview: To see everything on one screen I zoom the browser out on the week view and it crashes the tab right away. On a small monitor this is the only way to see all drivers. We've gone back to printed run sheets for planning.

conversations.subject: board issue
conversations.preview: Board is frozen again after the broker import finished. Closing the tab and reopening fixes it for about ten minutes.

conversations.subject: reassigning is slow
conversations.preview: reassigning is painfully slow. like fifteen clicks per trip. that's the whole ticket

conversations.subject: Reminder texts going out at 3am
conversations.preview: Our members are getting next-day reminder texts at 0300. We've had two angry callbacks and one family that thought it was an emergency. The reminder window should be during the day, say 6 to 8pm. Where is that setting, or is it a bug?

conversations.subject: scheduler lets me double book vehicles
conversations.preview: Is there any rule I can turn on to stop the same vehicle being assigned to two trips with overlapping times? Right now it accepts everything. We got a broker penalty on Tuesday because a van was in two places. Reply to ops.lead@example.org or call 312-555-0147, our billing person is cc'd.

conversations.subject: trip assigned to two drivers
conversations.preview: Trip 51907 shows assigned to a driver in the morning list and the same trip is on a second driver's manifest in the afternoon. Both got push notifications. One of them drove all the way out and found the rider gone.

conversations.subject: standing order dupes
conversations.preview: Standing order for the Tuesday/Thursday/Saturday dialysis run generated every trip twice this week. Two drivers per rider.

conversations.subject: Loaded miles show zero on the broker report
conversations.preview: Every wheelchair trip on Tuesday's report has loaded miles of 0.0. The odometer is fine on the board. Can you check the report?

conversations.subject: duplicate recurring transports
conversations.preview: Our recurring dialysis transport schedule shows every Monday transport twice since the last update. Crew called in thinking we'd doubled the runs. Please investigate and let us know if other accounts are seeing this.

conversations.subject: auto assign same-day adds?
conversations.preview: Can same-day adds auto-assign to the closest driver with the right level of service? We take about 30 a day and it's all manual.

conversations.subject: wheelchair van double booked!!
conversations.preview: The only lift van left was booked on two wheelchair trips 20 min apart across the county and I only caught it because a driver called. System should have stopped me.

conversations.subject: cant see tomorrows rides
conversations.preview: calendar wont open for tomorrow only, today is fine. we need to confirm our wound care rides before noon

conversations.subject: Pickup and drop-off times out of order
conversations.preview: A few drivers hit Picked Up and Dropped Off back to back at the end of the run because they were in a bad signal area. Now the board shows the drop-off 11 minutes before the pickup on trip 49440 and a couple of others. Whatever the app is doing with the timestamps when it reconnects, it should use the time of the tap, not the time of the sync.

conversations.subject: Month view crashes on first of the month
conversations.preview: We use month view to check our recurring dialysis transports are all present. On the first of the month it loads partway then turns white. We then have to pull the list one day at a time which takes hours. Could someone check whether the amount of data is the issue?

conversations.subject: Calendar fails after an update, third week
conversations.preview: Ever since the last release the week view fails to render about one load in three. Staff just reload until it works. It's a nuisance, but when it fails at 6am with the morning wave coming it turns into missed pickups. Do you know about this? Is there a fix date?

conversations.subject: suggested driver
conversations.preview: It would be great if the unassigned trip screen suggested a driver based on location and level of service. We know who is near the hospital because the dispatcher is watching the map, but a new hire has no idea. A top three suggestion with ETA to pickup would cut mistakes on same-day discharges a lot.

conversations.subject: manifest not re-sent after reassign
conversations.preview: After I reassign a trip I have to remember to re-send the manifest to the new driver as a separate step. Yesterday I forgot, the driver never saw the 1:30 wound care pickup, and the facility called us at 2:00. Reassigning should push the manifest by itself. The whole sequence is already too long without that extra step.

conversations.subject: Auto-assign trips to best available driver
conversations.preview: We would like the system to auto-assign trips to the best available driver. Right now our dispatchers go down the unassigned list one trip at a time, matching level of service (ambulatory, wheelchair, stretcher) and who is closest. Most mornings it's 60 to 80 trips between 0500 and 0700. If the system could pick the driver and flag the exceptions for a human, it would save us at least an hour a day. We would want it to respect pickup windows, vehicle capability and driver hours. Reach me at ops.lead@example.org if you want more detail on how we assign today.

conversations.subject: please remove extra pickup
conversations.preview: We cancelled the morning pickup and rebooked for the afternoon but the morning one still shows as active, so now there are two. Transport company says they can't tell which one to run. Can the portal prevent that?

conversations.subject: locked out
conversations.preview: I'm locked out after a couple of tries and the unlock email never came. I have a 6am shift. Please help.

conversations.subject: Driver call-off 6am: 20 minutes to move the manifest
conversations.preview: Writing this at 0640 while I'm still cleaning up. One of our wheelchair drivers called off at 0555. He had eight trips, five of them dialysis standing orders with 0715 to 0745 chair windows. For each trip I opened it, clicked unassign, confirmed the modal, searched the driver list, re-checked level of service, re-entered the pickup window, saved, and then went back to re-send the manifest. That's 13 clicks by my count, times eight. It took 20 minutes to move one manifest, and two of those pickups were late. We will get a call from the center. Please give us a bulk reassign button.

conversations.subject: Board stability: summary of what we've tried
conversations.preview: To save your team time, here is what we have already tried for the board freezing and going blank: cleared cache on all machines, tested Chrome, Edge and Firefox, disabled browser extensions, rebooted the router, moved two users to a wired connection, and tried a clean user profile. None of it changed anything. The issue is worst when more than 250 trips are loaded for the day and when filtering by level of service. It also logs people out when it recovers. We run mostly dialysis standing orders and some interfacility wheelchair transfers. I can arrange a screen share with a dispatcher at any time. Please escalate to someone who can look at the server side.

conversations.subject: Former employee could still log in
conversations.preview: We terminated a dispatcher two weeks ago and I deactivated her account the same day. This morning I saw from the audit log that her login was used on Sunday night and she opened the board and a few trip records. The account shows as inactive in the admin screen. I changed nothing since. I need to understand how a deactivated user got a session, whether her token stays valid after deactivation, and which trips she viewed. Our contract with the broker requires us to cut off access immediately, so this is something I might have to report. Please get back to me soon.

conversations.subject: calendar hangs when two of us are on it
conversations.preview: When a second dispatcher opens the same day view, both of us start lagging and one of us usually freezes up. Happens most when we are both reassigning stretcher transfers at once. We've started taking turns, which is a bad way to run a Friday afternoon.

conversations.subject: logged out again
conversations.preview: Drivers are getting logged out mid-run and have to re-enter the PIN with a rider on board. Several times a day now. Please fix.

conversations.subject: Month end. Spinner. 3 hours. Cool.
conversations.preview: Ran the month-end export at 5pm. Spinner. It is now 8pm. Great use of an evening.

conversations.subject: again
conversations.preview: Page unresponsive popup again on the board. Third time this week. Chrome keeps asking if I want to wait or kill it. Call me at 312-555-0147 if you need me to share my screen.

conversations.subject: Please add our unit inbox to ETA alerts
conversations.preview: Our transport desk is staffed by two people and neither of them has the cell phone that the text alerts go to. Can you send the ETA and arrival alerts to our shared inbox, transport.desk@example.net, instead of the one coordinator's phone? She is off on Fridays and the Friday dialysis returns are where we lose track.

conversations.subject: Calendar logging everyone out
conversations.preview: When the calendar crashes it also kicks the user out to the login page. Lost whatever they were typing. Happening to several dispatchers.

conversations.subject: Passwords expiring every 30 days is too much
conversations.preview: Our dispatchers are forced to change passwords every 30 days and the rules have gotten so strict people write them on sticky notes next to the console. Two were locked out last week during the morning surge. Can we set the expiry to 90 days or turn it off and rely on two-factor instead?

conversations.subject: Van 14 on two trips at once
conversations.preview: Van 14 is on the board for a 0545 pickup and a 0555 pickup across town from each other. The system saved both with no warning. Why no overlap check?

conversations.subject: no pickup text
conversations.preview: The patient never got the pickup text for her 6:30 ride and waited outside in the cold for 40 minutes not knowing if the van was coming.

conversations.subject: facility complaint over duplicate trips
conversations.preview: A dialysis center emailed our director because they saw two of our vans idling outside and a rider waiting while a third sat in a chair on the portal. The cause was a duplicate return leg created when the facility edited the ride. No money changed hands but this is a relationship issue. Needs a fix.

conversations.subject: day view dead at shift start
conversations.preview: Day view froze at 0545 with the whole morning dialysis wave on it. Reloaded twice, still dead. Calling crews with their first pickups by phone.

conversations.subject: standing order created overlapping trips
conversations.preview: After we extended a dialysis standing order, the system kept the old recurring series and created a new one, so every rider on it has two trips each day. We caught it on Wednesday when drivers started reporting riders already gone. Please clean up the old series and tell us how to prevent this when editing a standing order.

conversations.subject: call-off, moving 11 trips by hand
conversations.preview: Driver called off at 0545 and I'm moving 11 trips by hand. We need bulk reassign. 20 minutes gone already.

conversations.subject: patient picked up late because ride was double booked
conversations.preview: Our discharge from the med-surg floor was booked twice by two different nurses on the portal, and the dispatcher at the transport company cancelled one thinking it was the duplicate. It was the one with the correct pickup window. Patient sat in the lobby for almost two hours. Is there a way for the portal to tell us when a ride already exists for that patient?

conversations.subject: can't find a setting to stop overlapping bookings
conversations.preview: I have been asked by our director to find out why our system allows the same driver to be assigned two trips with overlapping pickup windows. I checked the admin settings and the dispatcher permissions and I can't find any rule on conflicts. Support told me last month it might be possible with a custom setting, but I don't see it. Our need: when a dispatcher assigns a trip, the system should warn if the driver already has a trip in that window, unless it's flagged as multi-load. We are getting broker penalties and drivers are getting upset because they are being sent to two places. Please tell me whether this is configurable or whether I should file it as a feature request. You can cc our billing person at accounts@example.com.

conversations.subject: Board crashes if I open a will-call
conversations.preview: Opening a pending will-call return from the board sometimes crashes the calendar. The one I opened today was a dialysis return, and the patient was already ready. We were late 25 minutes because I had to reload and find it again.

conversations.subject: driver list
conversations.preview: The driver list in the reassign screen shows every driver. I need a stretcher van and can't filter by vehicle type, so I scroll.

conversations.subject: spinning forever
conversations.preview: Calendar spinner never stops on the week view. Using my phone and calling drivers directly until it comes back.

conversations.subject: reassign to a crew that already has a transfer
conversations.preview: When I search for a crew during reassignment the list does not show who is already committed in that time window, so I pick someone, save, and then find out they have a transfer overlapping. It happened three times this month. Each time I had to unassign and start the entire flow again, which is about 14 clicks and a reload. The list should be filtered by availability and level of service, or at least warn me before I save. One of the overlaps had us double dispatched on a discharge from the hospital and the charge nurse was not pleased. Please look at this, it is costing us on-time performance with the broker.

conversations.subject: reassign + driver app notifications
conversations.preview: Two issues that feel connected. First, reassigning a trip takes too many steps: unassign, confirm, search, level of service, pickup window, save. My team estimates 14 clicks. Second, after we finally reassign, the new driver often doesn't see the trip in the driver app until they restart it, so we end up phoning them anyway. On a bad morning we lose 20+ minutes on one manifest and still have drivers who don't know what they're running. I'd be happy with either fix but both together would change our mornings.

conversations.subject: Our discharge planners keep calling your dispatch line
conversations.preview: Because we don't get any alert when a driver is assigned or on the way, our discharge planners call your dispatch line for an update on every single discharge ride. Yesterday between noon and 3 they made 14 calls, and each one is a nurse who should be with a patient. Can we get a text or email to the unit when the ride is assigned, when the driver is en route, and when they arrive at the floor? Right now we find out the driver is here when he walks up to the desk. We use the portal to book and that part is fine, it's just the silence afterward.

conversations.subject: Board white screen
conversations.preview: The board goes completely white every time I open the week view. Refresh does nothing. Back to paper run sheets.

conversations.subject: export timing out again
conversations.preview: The billing export is timing out again. Same as last month.

conversations.subject: wheelchair van double booking again
conversations.preview: We only have two lift vans on the weekend and the system keeps letting me book one of them on trips that overlap. Saturday it was a 0830 will-call return from a wound care clinic and a 0845 ambulatory-to-wheelchair change on the other end of the county. I realized when the driver messaged me from the driver app that he couldn't be in two places. I had to find a taxi voucher for the second rider, who then complained to their broker. I'm not asking for magic, just a yellow flag when the same vehicle has overlapping pickup windows. We can override if we need to.

conversations.subject: Call-off at 6am took 20 minutes to move one manifest
conversations.preview: Driver called off at 0550 this morning with nine trips on the manifest, mostly dialysis standing orders with 0700 chair times. Between unassigning, confirming the modal, searching the driver list, rechecking level of service and retyping the pickup window on each one, it took 20 minutes and two patients were already waiting at the curb. There has to be a faster way to move a manifest. - Marisol, dispatch lead

conversations.subject: Stretcher patient arrival not announced
conversations.preview: We had a stretcher transfer scheduled for the 11:30 slot and nobody at the receiving unit got an arrival alert, so the crew sat in the bay for 15 minutes waiting for an escort. The sending side shows arrived at 11:42. We need an alert to the receiving unit's desk or this will keep happening.

conversations.subject: Report leaves out anything after 8pm
conversations.preview: Our daily transport report seems to drop any transfer that starts after 8pm. I checked three nights and each time the late transfers are on the board and in the trip log but not in the report. My guess is the date filter is converting to UTC. Our night crew's volume is getting under-reported to the county.

conversations.subject: safari vs chrome on the board
conversations.preview: The board freezes on Safari on our front desk machine but works on Chrome in the back office. Front desk is the one who takes same-day adds so it matters. Is Safari supported? We can switch but I'd like to know what to tell the team.

conversations.subject: reassigned trip now on two manifests
conversations.preview: Moved a discharge trip to another driver during the lunch rush and the system still showed it on the first driver's manifest for a few minutes. Both of them headed to the same hospital entrance. Is the page reload hiding stale data? Reassign takes so long that I rush the save step and then wonder if it went through.

conversations.subject: Week view won't load for a particular vehicle
conversations.preview: One of our BLS units never loads in the week view. Everything else loads, but when that vehicle is selected the calendar hangs and I have to refresh. I think it has a lot of recurring dialysis legs. Other units with fewer trips are fine.

conversations.subject: Overnight trips make the day view crash
conversations.preview: Interfacility trips that cross midnight seem to break the day view. When one of those is on the board the whole day goes white after a few seconds. We removed the trip and it loaded fine. Can you check how the calendar handles overnight BLS transfers?

conversations.subject: stretcher unit double booked on discharge
conversations.preview: Stretcher unit 5 was assigned to a hospital discharge at 1100 and a nursing home transfer at 1115. I did not get any message when I dragged the second trip onto the unit. We ended up using a backup contractor, which is real money.

conversations.subject: Blank manifest this morning
conversations.preview: Drivers opened the app at 0615 and the manifest was blank for six runs. I read the trips off the board over the radio until it came back around 0800.

conversations.subject: Reassign UX feedback
conversations.preview: Feedback from the crew chiefs: the reassign modal asks for confirmation, then you search for the unit, then it makes you re-pick level of service even though the trip already has one. It's 10 clicks for something that should be one drag. Also nothing tells you the save worked other than the page refreshing.

conversations.subject: No-show count on the report doesn't match the board
conversations.preview: The no-show report shows 31 for the month. When I filter the board for failed trips with the no-show reason code, I get 24. I can't tell which one to give the hospital partner for our monthly review, and they will ask.

conversations.subject: page keeps reloading
conversations.preview: Every reassign reloads the whole page and dumps me back at the top of the board. I lose my place every single time.

conversations.subject: Calendar broke after last night's update
conversations.preview: Whatever you pushed last night, the calendar now throws a blank white page for half our staff. Same browser version as before, so it's not us.

conversations.subject: Filtering by wheelchair level of service hangs
conversations.preview: I filter the day view to wheelchair only so I can see who's open for the next will-call. Since this week that filter makes the browser hang for a long time and sometimes crash the tab. Removing the filter works. Using the vehicle filter has the same problem.

conversations.subject: Our monthly trip report counts cancelled rides as completed
conversations.preview: I pull the monthly trip report from the portal to reconcile with our transport budget. This month it shows 212 completed trips, but our own records say about 190. When I looked, cancelled and failed trips are in the completed total. Our finance team won't accept the report as it stands. Is there a filter that excludes them, or is the status column wrong?

conversations.subject: don't need AI, need the calendar to stop crashing
conversations.preview: I keep getting emails about AI dispatch. I don't need AI, I need the calendar to stop crashing first. It freezes at least twice a week when I load Monday, and then I'm back on paper. Fix that and then we can talk about assistants.

conversations.subject: duplicate return leg
conversations.preview: Return leg for our wound care patient is on the portal twice, both will-call. Can someone remove the extra before a second van shows up?

conversations.subject: Edits disappear when the board refreshes itself
conversations.preview: I have heard from several dispatchers that the board refreshes by itself and wipes out a trip they were editing, usually right after a crash recovery. No warning, no draft. Could you add an autosave or at least warn before the refresh? Right now they type notes into a text file first.

conversations.subject: ride showing up twice
conversations.preview: Our 7am dialysis rider shows two bookings on the portal for Thursday. Which one is real? Don't want two vans sent.

conversations.subject: two dispatchers same trip
conversations.preview: Me and the night lead both assigned trip 48213 to different drivers a minute apart. No conflict shown. One of them drove out for nothing.

conversations.subject: same ride booked by two people on our team
conversations.preview: Two of our schedulers booked the same wheelchair ride for tomorrow's chemo appointment because the portal doesn't show that someone already submitted it. Now the transport company has two trips for the same pickup window. We would love a warning when a ride already exists for that patient and time.

conversations.subject: I'm tired of calling drivers because the board dies
conversations.preview: Honestly I'm tired. Every other morning the board dies around the peak and I end up calling drivers one by one to read them their next trips. At 6am I can make about fifteen calls before the next wave of will-calls comes in, and I have eleven drivers on dialysis runs. Two drivers had the same patient on their list last Friday because the board froze after I reassigned and the change didn't save. I'm not blaming anyone personally, but please tell me what is going on, because I'm the one the facilities yell at.

conversations.subject: no warning on overlapping pickup window
conversations.preview: I understand the system lets you overbook for multi-loading, fine, but a driver with two wheelchair riders going to different centers at the same minute is not multi-loading. Can the check at least consider destination, not just time?

conversations.subject: Browser memory climbing on the board
conversations.preview: Our dispatchers keep the board open all day and by mid afternoon Chrome is using several gigabytes and the board slows to a crawl. Restarting the tab helps. Is the board leaking memory? Staff have started reloading every hour as a habit.

conversations.subject: Level of service column says ambulatory for everything
conversations.preview: In the CSV export, the level of service column reads ambulatory on every row, including the stretcher and wheelchair trips. The board and the trip detail screen show them correctly. The broker rejected our batch because stretcher trips were billed as ambulatory, which is a lower rate, so if we send it as-is we get underpaid and if we fix by hand it takes all day.

conversations.subject: Can't enter discharge trips - calendar spins
conversations.preview: We had two hospital discharges today and the calendar spun for over five minutes each time we tried to book. Both patients ended up waiting an extra hour because we had to phone the booking line instead. Our floor nurses are not happy with us.

conversations.subject: 14 clicks to move one trip
conversations.preview: Why does moving one trip to a different driver take 14 clicks? Open trip, unassign, confirm the modal, search drivers, level of service again, pickup window again, save. Please fix this.

conversations.subject: calendar breaks when a long note is saved
conversations.preview: One of our crews pasted a very long note into a trip and now the day view for that date won't load for anyone. Removing the note by hand through support fixed it last time. Can you make the calendar tolerant of this? It took a whole morning to find the cause.

conversations.subject: Page unresponsive on the manifest and board tabs
conversations.preview: Having the board and a driver manifest open in separate tabs triggers the unresponsive page warning on the board within minutes. Using one tab only works but then I lose my place. Not sure when this started; it was fine in the summer.

conversations.subject: lose my place on the board
conversations.preview: Small thing but it adds up. After every reassignment the board jumps back to the top and the 6am column. If I'm working the 2pm block I have to scroll back down each time. Over a full call-off morning that's dozens of scrolls. Keep the scroll position please.

conversations.subject: duplicates AGAIN
conversations.preview: Duplicate trips from the broker import again this morning. 11 of them. Third time this week.

conversations.subject: bulk reassign when a crew goes out of service
conversations.preview: When a unit goes out of service mid-shift, we have to reassign each scheduled transfer one by one. Each takes about 11 clicks and a page reload, so a crew with six transfers eats up half an hour of dispatcher time while 911 calls are also coming in. Is there any plan for bulk reassign, or even a suggestion of which crews are free with matching level of service? Right now the dispatcher has to keep all that in their head and click through a long form for every transfer. Happy to jump on a call and show our workflow.

conversations.subject: Same text twice every time
conversations.preview: Every ride we book sends the unit two identical pickup texts, a minute apart. Staff have started ignoring them, which defeats the point.

conversations.subject: Manifest changes not reaching drivers since the update
conversations.preview:
Since the update last Thursday, any change I make to a manifest after the driver has started their run does not show up in the driver app. This morning I moved a 7:15 dialysis pickup off van 4 and onto van 6 because van 4 was running behind. The board showed the reassign went through. Van 6 never got it, and van 4 went to the house anyway and found nobody to pick up. Then the facility called at 7:50 asking where their rider was. I had to phone both drivers to sort it out. This is the third morning this week. Drivers only see the change if they force-close the app and reopen it, which they are obviously not doing while driving.
- Marisol, dispatch lead

conversations.subject: Calendar crash caused a missed dialysis pickup
conversations.preview: Writing this up properly because it ended in a missed pickup. At 5:40 this morning the board froze with about sixty trips unassigned for the first wave. I reloaded, got logged out, logged back in, and the week view spun for a good four minutes. By then two wheelchair dialysis riders were already past their pickup window. We called the drivers directly, but one was nowhere near. The facility filed a complaint and our broker will probably count it as a late. I understand software has bad days, but this is the third freezing episode this month. What can you tell me about root cause? - Marisol, dispatch lead
